exposure: COVID-19 pandemic-imposed changes (e.g., lockdown measures, local Health System reorganization)
Transformation of Schiavonia Hospital into a COVID-dedicated hospital
outcome: Attitudes in relation to the pandemic and its effect on birth plans
Attitudes regarding giving birth in a COVID hospital
Trust in the facility and obstetrics ward
cohort: Pregnant women (n=104) who gave birth in Schiavonia Hospital between May and September 2020.
finding: Despite the hospital's transformation into a COVID-dedicated facility, women expressed high trust in the obstetrics ward, found communication exhaustive, and rated healthcare assistance received at a high level.
cross-section timing: The survey was conducted among women who gave birth between May and September 2020.
